title: Game Room
subtitle: Focused table game room for direct matches with live AI slots or the connected US1 remote user.

backgammon.heroSubtitle: Pick AI1, AI2, or US1, choose who starts, and play a turn-based Tavla match with legal move commands.

topbar.inviteMessagePlaceholder: Add an optional note for the protocol or the remote invite mail.
topbar.inviteMessageHintAi: When AI1 or AI2 is selected, this note is prepended only to the first protocol message.
topbar.inviteMessageHintUs1: When US1 is selected, this note is sent only in the invite mail.

board.title: Board
board.fallbackMovesHint: Drag checkers on the board; these buttons stay as a compact fallback.
board.noMoves: No legal moves for this turn.
board.dragHint: Drag a checker to a highlighted point.
board.stageIdle: Start a match to open the board.

side.title: Live Opponents
side.latestMessageHint: Only the latest assistant message is scanned for commands.
side.help1: 1. Choose a connected AI slot and decide who opens the match.
side.help2: 2. When it is your turn, choose one legal move.
side.help3: 3. Every AI turn receives dice, board state, token, and legal move ids.

status.roomApiUnavailable: Room API bridge is not connected.
status.commandSendFailed: The command could not be sent to the room host.
status.idle: Choose a ready opponent or respond to an incoming invite.

invites.title: Invites
invites.pendingOutgoing: Invite sent. Waiting for a reply.

teamTetris.heroSubtitle: A four-seat, turn-based deduction Tetris match for the local user, AI1, AI2, and the connected US1 remote user.

controls.partnerPending: Pick one teammate before the match starts.
controls.partnerHint: The chosen seat joins USER. The remaining two seats become the other team.
controls.startHint: The match starts only when AI1, AI2, and US1 are ready. If pairs are visible from the start, the local partner must be selected first.
controls.awaitingTurn: Waiting for the local user's turn packet.
controls.pathHint: Rotate the piece, then draw the fall and side-shift route you expect to work.
controls.pathReady: The visible-board route is ready. After your last planned step, the piece continues straight down on its own.
controls.pathRule: Each downward step may shift left 1, stay, or shift right 1. If the route is blocked early, the piece stays there; if the route ends with open air below, it keeps falling straight down.

boards.noPartnerPiece: No partner piece has been locked yet.
boards.publicHint: The opposing team board only shows the latest public state.

status.roomApiUnavailable: Room API bridge is not connected.
status.commandSendFailed: The command could not be sent to the room host.
status.idle: Waiting for AI1, AI2, and US1 before Team Tetris can start.
status.ready: All required seats are ready. The Team Tetris opener can be seeded.
status.activeFeatureReset: Leaving the Team Tetris feature resets the active Team Tetris match.
status.blocked: This Team Tetris match is blocked. Reset to recover.
status.yourTurn: Your turn. Rotate the piece, draw the route you expect, and submit the move.
status.partnerTurnHidden: Your teammate is acting, but the hidden pairing keeps their identity concealed for now.
status.partnerTurn: Your teammate is acting on your board.
status.opponentTurn: The opposing team is taking its turn.
status.team-a-win: Team A survived longer and won the match.
status.team-b-win: Team B survived longer and won the match.
status.draw: Both teams topped out together. The match ends in a draw.

roster.title: Seat View
roster.hiddenHint: Pair identities stay hidden until the match ends.
roster.revealedHint: Pair identities are now visible for both teams.

validation.invalidRotation: This rotation is not legal for the current piece.
validation.invalidRowShifts: The drawn path contains an illegal sideways step.
validation.spawnCollision: The piece cannot spawn on the current board.
validation.horizontalCollision: The drafted route hits a filled cell on the visible board while shifting sideways.
validation.downwardCollision: The drafted route hits a filled cell on the visible board while moving down.
validation.incompletePath: If the route ends here, the piece finishes the remaining fall straight down.
